sentences.text:
Our attention has been drawn by Mr. Sanjay Hegde, learned senior counsel appearing for the appellant, to an order dated 5 th December, 2025 in Criminal Appeal No. 5245 of 2025 passed by a coordinate Bench of this Court whereby the gang leader, Rinku Kumar Sharma, has been granted bail.
6.
We have heard learned counsel appearing for the parties and perused the materials on record.
7. The prosecution proposes to examine around 150 witnesses to drive home the charges against the appellant and the co-accused, being 133 in number.
Of them, 57 accused have been granted bail.
8. Having regard to the fact and circumstances, there is very likelihood of the trial taking sufficient time to conclude.
Since number of co-accused have been granted bail, we are inclined to accept the present appeal.
9. Accordingly, we set aside the impugned judgment and order insofar as the same denies bail to the appellant.
10. Appellant shall be released on bail, subject to such terms and conditions as may be imposed by the trial court.
11. We clarify that the observations made in this order and grant of bail will not be treated as findings on the merits of the case.

12. Appellant shall, however, appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless exempted; and should the appellant fail to appear on any date without justifiable cause or breach any of the terms and conditions for grant of bail, the trial court shall be at liberty to cancel the bail.
13.
The appeal is, accordingly, allowed on the aforesaid terms.
14. Pending interlocutory application(s), if any, stand disposed of.
.....J. [DIPANKAR DATTA] .....J. [SATISH CHANDRA SHARMA
] New Delhi;
January 05, 2026.
